Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

1. Scopa — Specifies the requirements for rope ladders for mountaineering.

FIG. 1 DIMENSIONS FOR ROPE LADDERS 

3. Material 

3.1 Steps of the rope ladder shall be manufactured from suitable alloy sheet. 

3.2 Rope shall be manufactured from suitable braided nylon cord. The braided nylon cord shall have a 
minimum tensile strength of 1 800 N. 

4. General Requirements — Holes in the steps shall be without sharp edges so as not to damage the 
rope. The steps shall be given anodic coatings to Grade AC 15 of IS : 1868-1982 'Specification for 
anodic coating on aluminium ( second revision )'.

IS I 11074-1984 

5. Marking — Rope ladders shall be marked with the manufacturer's name or recognized trade-mark. 

6, ISI Certification Marking — Details available with the Indian Standards institution. 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

Although the mass of rope ladders has not been specified, but all efforts should be made to 
keep the mass as minimum as possible without affecting the strength of the ladders.
